svg.title: Inside the TMC5160A
svg.desc: Block diagram of the TMC5160A: its function blocks, how they connect and which package pins reach each block.
svg.text: Function blocks and their links, from the datasheet's block diagram (1 Principles of Operation, p. 5). Pins on the edge carry their package number.
